name: Warrior - Lodestone Colossus
description: This playstyle shifts the Warrior from a brute-force brawler into an active combat tracker. You are no longer just watching health bars; you are managing the encounter's spatial geometry and dictating exactly where enemies and allies are allowed to be.

bonuses.text: Shield Slam detonations knock enemies an additional 5 yards into the air.

items.name: The Singularity Anchor
items.stats:
+150 Strength
+120 Stamina
Equip: Alters Thunder Clap to consume extra Rage, creating a persistent Gravity Well effect that pulls enemies inward.
items.flavor: A dormant core awakened to warp the battlefield.

origin.details: Drops from an elemental or golem boss in a mid-tier, Titan-themed dungeon (like Uldaman or Ulduar).

items.name: Kinetic Sabatons
items.stats:
+120 Strength
+140 Stamina
Equip: Converts Charge and Intercept into coordinate-targeted or ally-targeted abilities, applying a kinetic barrier upon landing.
items.flavor: Heavy enough to shatter the earth, padded enough to save the wearer.

origin.details: A rare drop from a massive elite giant roaming an endgame mountainous zone.

items.name: The Event Horizon
items.stats:
+180 Strength
+220 Stamina
Equip: Detonates active Gravity Wells with Shield Slam, converting absorbed kinetic energy into an AoE knock-up and stun.

origin.details: A highly contested drop from a physical-damage-heavy raid boss in an endgame tier.
